summary: uri options: attributes, body, body_format (raw, json, form-urlencoded, form-multipart) which sets Content-Type, and ca_path.
questions: How do I send a JSON body with the uri module?
How do I submit a form with uri?
How do I upload files with multipart in uri?
How do I trust a custom CA for uri?
Can I override Content-Type with body_format json?

answer_card.title: uri body and body_format
answer_card.answer_md:
- `body`: request body
- `body_format`: `raw` (default), `json` (dict → JSON), `form-urlencoded` (dict/list of tuples), `form-multipart` (files; `multipart_encoding` per file). Sets `Content-Type` automatically; can override for json/form-urlencoded via `headers`, not for multipart.
- `ca_path`: CA cert PEM
